name: Stat
description: A single headline number with its label, its change and the context for it. The change is an arrow and text, never color alone. Put stats side by side with a layout component such as Grid, and emphasize at most one in a row.

livewire.name: stat
capabilities: The icon slot replaces the named icon
2.x title, changeLabel and the trailing description still work, as label and description

react.name: Stat
capabilities: children replace value; icon takes a name or a node

vue.name: Stat
capabilities: The default slot replaces value; the icon slot replaces the named icon

props.name: label
props.description: What the number measures, above it.

props.name: value
props.description: The number, already formatted ("$348,261", "10.87%"). Rendered with tabular figures.

props.name: unit
props.description: A unit after the value, smaller and muted ("ms", "kg").

props.name: icon
props.description: A registry icon name for the tile at the end of the label row, tinted by color. Decorative.

props.name: delta
props.description: The change as text ("10.9%", "6.2 hrs"), shown with an arrow for trend. Takes precedence over change.

props.name: change
props.description: The change as a percentage. Shown as delta with one decimal and no sign ("5.4%"), and sets trend from its sign when trend isn't set.

props.name: trend
props.description: The change's direction: an up or down arrow in success or error text, or a dash. Emitted as data-trend on delta.
props.a11y: The arrow is decorative; upLabel, downLabel or flatLabel is read before the delta, so the direction isn't only color or shape.

props.name: description
props.description: Context after the delta ("vs last month").

props.name: size
props.description: The value's type style: stat-sm, stat-md or stat-lg. Size carries the hierarchy, never bold.

props.name: color
props.description: Tints the icon tile and the emphasis fill. It doesn't color the value.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: A soft fill in color for the one stat that matters in a row. Emitted as data-emphasis.

props.name: bare
props.description: No container: no padding, border or fill, for a stat inside a Card. Emitted as data-bare.

props.name: upLabel
props.description: Hidden text before an up delta. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Increase' ).

props.name: downLabel
props.description: Hidden text before a down delta. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Decrease' ).

props.name: flatLabel
props.description: Hidden text before a flat delta. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'No change' ).

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { value: '…', delta: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The container, with data-size, data-color, data-emphasis and data-bare.

parts.name: top
parts.description: The label row: label at the start, icon at the end.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: The tinted icon tile. Hidden from assistive technology.

parts.name: unit
parts.description: The unit inside the value, smaller and muted.

parts.name: delta
parts.description: The change: hidden direction text, an arrow and the change, with data-trend.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Replaces the named icon in the tile.

requirements: The change is visible text with an arrow, and a hidden direction label (upLabel, downLabel, flatLabel): color is never the only signal.
The value uses tabular figures; the label and description keep 4.5:1 (--apui-text-muted) on the default and emphasis fills.
Up and down deltas keep 4.5:1 in success and error text.
The icon tile is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
